k1_pip.mp3.transcript: My village is covered in 9,000 carpets. The road, carpet. The stairs, carpet. The dog house, also carpet. We shear 300 sheep every morning to keep up. Even our bell is wrapped in white wool. The dog on the hill hasn't moved in 900 days. Not for rain, not for thunder, not for creepers, not even zombies. I bring him a bone every morning. He never looks.
k1_pip.mp3.would_you_keep_listening: yes, intriguing Minecraft storyline keeps viewer very engaged
